question: Identify the simplest compound formed by carbon that is used widely as fuel.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Methane**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Methane is the simplest hydrocarbon with the chemical formula CH₄.
 
• It is a primary component of natural gas, making it a widely used fuel.
 
• Methane is a colorless, odorless gas under standard temperature and pressure conditions.
 
• It is used in residential heating, cooking, and electricity generation.
 
• Methane has a high energy content per unit of mass, making it an efficient fuel source.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ethane**

 
 
• Ethane is a hydrocarbon with the formula C₂H₆, used as a petrochemical feedstock.
 
• It is less commonly used as fuel compared to methane.
 
 
 
• **Propane**
 
 
• Propane, with the formula C₃H₈, is used as fuel for heating, cooking, and in vehicles.
 
• It is stored as a liquid in pressurized tanks.
 
 
 
• **Butane**
 
 
• Butane, C₄H₁₀, is used in lighters, portable stoves, and as a propellant in aerosol sprays.
 
• It is also a component of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG).
